evidence.dominant_driver: At UNGA Trump combined explicit escalation ('deal or annihilate') and calls for economic isolation with a claim that a US-Iran deal will ultimately get done, creating a high-volatility two-sided geopolitical signal.

market_expectations.expected_value: Markets had leaned toward de-escalation and lower oil before the speech.
market_expectations.distribution_notes: No meeting is scheduled; deal timing was pushed to after the US midterms in one remark.

absorption.reason: Despite stronger rhetoric, oil remained below $100 and US equities stayed near records, indicating the market did not reprice immediately into broad escalation.

evidence.decision_notes: High-attention fresh catalyst but internally contradictory; volatility is more defensible than a one-way immediate call. Empty learning profile.
